what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Indonesia, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 35672 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence; UNHCR reports no figure above zero for that year.
Refugees from Indonesia live mostly in Papua New Guinea.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Aceh territory with GAM from 2003 to 2005, and over West Papua territory with the OPM from 2018 to 2025.
Earthquakes, floods, mass movements, storms and volcanic activity are the disasters recorded for Indonesia in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 70000 in 2009 to 200000 in 2010, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2010 to 2012.
The figure was much lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements from disasters in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
